verdict.rationale: Grok Build is documented as a terminal coding agent with a TUI, a headless mode, and ACP. Inline completions are a fair question for a coding tool, but no evidence shows it offers as-you-type completions or next-edit suggestions. The mention that the grok-4.7 model can be dropped into your own IDE integration is a developer building block on the API, not a product capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can receive inline code completions and next-edit suggestions as I type
